preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.label_preset p WHERE p.is_system = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.label_preset_field f WHERE f.preset_id = p.id AND f.field_key <> 'LAB_NUMBER') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Seed the v1 carry-over content fields of each system preset from the legacy site_information element keys (OGC-1218)
changeSet.sql: WITH mapping(preset_name, legacy_key, field_key, position) AS (VALUES ('Order Label', 'orderLabelPatientName', 'PATIENT_NAME', 2), ('Order Label', 'orderLabelPatientDob', 'PATIENT_DOB', 3), ('Order Label', 'orderLabelPatientId', 'PATIENT_ID', 4), ('Order Label', 'orderLabelSiteId', 'SITE_ID', 5), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelPatientName', 'PATIENT_NAME', 2), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelPatientDob', 'PATIENT_DOB', 3), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelPatientId', 'PATIENT_ID', 4), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelPatientSex', 'PATIENT_SEX', 5), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelCollectionDate', 'COLLECTION_DATETIME', 6), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelCollectedBy', 'COLLECTED_BY', 7), ('Specimen Label', 'specimenLabelTests', 'TESTS', 8), ('Slide Label', 'slideLabelPatientId', 'PATIENT_ID', 2), ('Slide Label', 'slideLabelSlideId', 'SLIDE_ID', 3), ('Slide Label', 'slideLabelStainType', 'STAIN_TYPE', 4), ('Slide Label', 'slideLabelBlockId', 'BLOCK_ID', 5), ('Slide Label', 'slideLabelCaseNumber', 'CASE_NUMBER', 6), ('Block Label', 'blockLabelPatientId', 'PATIENT_ID', 2), ('Block Label', 'blockLabelBlockId', 'BLOCK_ID', 3), ('Block Label', 'blockLabelSpecimenType', 'SPECIMEN_TYPE', 4), ('Block Label', 'blockLabelCaseNumber', 'CASE_NUMBER', 5), ('Freezer Label', 'freezerLabelPatientId', 'PATIENT_ID', 2), ('Freezer Label', 'freezerLabelStorageLocation', 'STORAGE_LOCATION', 3), ('Freezer Label', 'freezerLabelSpecimenType', 'SPECIMEN_TYPE', 4), ('Freezer Label', 'freezerLabelCollectionDate', 'COLLECTION_DATETIME', 5), ('Freezer Label', 'freezerLabelExpiryDate', 'EXPIRY_DATE', 6) ), wanted AS ( SELECT p.id AS preset_id, m.field_key, m.position FROM mapping m JOIN clinlims.label_preset p ON p.name = m.preset_name AND p.is_system = true LEFT JOIN clinlims.site_information si ON si.name = m.legacy_key WHERE COALESCE(lower(trim(si.value)), 'true') <> 'false' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.label_preset_field f WHERE f.preset_id = p.id AND f.field_key <> 'LAB_NUMBER') ), ordered AS ( SELECT preset_id, field_key, 1 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY preset_id ORDER BY position) AS display_order FROM wanted ) INSERT INTO clinlims.label_preset_field (id, preset_id, field_key, source_type, is_required, display_order, last_updated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.label_preset_field_seq'), preset_id, field_key, 'SYSTEM', false, display_order, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ordered;
